title: Blood eosinophil–neutrophil interaction does not establish incremental prediction of bronchodilator response across NHANES cycles
abstract: In an exploratory NHANES2007–2008 to2011–2012 transfer among selected bronchodilator-tested adults (340 source;255 target), adding a blood eosinophil–neutrophil interaction changed weighted FEV1-response MSE by -44.5 mL² (joint PSU-bootstrap95% interval -678.2 to 1032.9). Incremental predictive benefit was not established.
